name: valetkey
description: A browser that is logged in to one site and can reach only the hosts that site needs, through valetkey.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to valetkey, which must be installed on the same Linux machine. The agent gets a headless browser signed in to one site, contained by a network namespace and a proxy that allows only the hosts that site needs.

tools.name: browser_sites
tools.description: List the sites that are set up and their state.

tools.name: browser_login
tools.description: Open a login window so the person can sign in to a site.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Start the signed-in browser for a site.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Read the page as a text tree.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element on the page.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Go to an address on an allowed host.

tools.name: browser_downloads
tools.description: List the files the browser has saved.

tools.name: browser_save
tools.description: Save a picture, a video or a linked file into the site's downloads folder.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take an image of the page.

tools.name: browser_allow
tools.description: Ask the person to let the site reach more hosts, up to ten at once.

tools.name: browser_deny
tools.description: Ask the person to stop the site reaching hosts it reaches now, up to ten at once.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: End the site's browser. The login stays saved.
